words.name: technique-effects
words.spec: A technique's `effects` list may hold {"name": <library Effect name>, "unlock_layer": n, "passive_art": true, "rule": ...}. When a build knows the technique at layer n or above (fight.py `tech_layers`, the GDScript FighterCompiler), the loader adds that Effect from assets/data/combat_effects.json and merges its counters. Matches Thiên Xu, Lạc Hà, Thúy Vi, and Phượng Minh's pending word of the same name.
words.gdd_text: Công Pháp rule (passive arts & technique effects): a technique may carry named Effects with an unlock layer; known to that layer, the Effect is always on in a fight without taking an art slot.
words.decision_reason: Already approved 'build' in this batch (thien_xu / lac_ha / thuy_vi / phuong_minh). armillary-array-canon carries The Twelve Hours (d16) as a passive art Effect at unlock_layer 4; its runtime record lives in effects/cung_tinh.effects.json and waits for the serial step to wire technique-effects into export_techniques.py, fight.py, and GDScript FighterCompiler.
